claims: A 16-seed has beaten a 1-seed in the men's NCAA tournament twice in history.
16-seeds have a 2-158 record against 1-seeds in the men's NCAA tournament since 1985.
In 2018, UMBC (University of Maryland, Baltimore County) beat #1 Virginia 74-54.
UMBC was the first 16-seed to beat a 1-seed in the men's NCAA tournament.
FDU was the second 16-seed to beat a 1-seed in the men's NCAA tournament five years after UMBC.
